verdict.rationale: The evidence documents a no-code editor for building verification flows, plus Dashboard review and override of sessions. None of these is a way for an ops user to send a verification to someone. Nothing in the pack mentions a shareable no-code link, a QR code, or any Dashboard-initiated send to a one-off customer, contractor, or seller, so the no-code flow editor is only an adjacent capability.

support.subject: As an ops lead, I can send a verification to someone with a no-code link or QR code — no engineering ticket to verify a one-off customer, contractor, or seller
